newsitem.title: USA: Derlan Industries sub sets $110 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Derlan Industries sub sets $110 mln in debt.

text.p: The following 144a private placement of high-yield bonds from Derlan Manufacturing Inc, a subsidiary of Derlan Industries Ltd, was priced on Friday by BT Securities Inc, according to market sources.
Derlan Industries is a Toronto-based diversified aerospace and industrial manufacturing company.
TYPE SNR UNSEC NOTES ISS PRICE 100 FIRST PAY DATE 7/15/97
LAST MOODY'S B3 YIELD 10 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P B-PLUS SPREAD N/A CALLABLE NON-CALLABLE
NOTES: Three-year equity call for 35 percent of issue at 110. The deal was upsized to $110 million from an original amount of $100 million.
